item.title: Far-right British provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos arrested by US immigration enforcement
item.description: Immigration officials have arrested British far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos in New Orleans. The Department of Homeland Security says he was detained at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport on Thursday.
